ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; the visible ventral surface is approximately 98% low-intensity (dark) pixels with negligible high-intensity (white) coverage.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark-field mapping across the entire fluke surface with minor high-intensity coordinate clusters localized at the distal lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate vertex angle of 60 degrees; depth is significant relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth serrations along the primary trailing edge boundary, with increased irregularity and amplitude at the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge trajectory meeting the leading edge at sharpened distal points, creating a tapered wing-like profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular pixel clusters detected at the lateral tips of both lobes, suggesting calcified deposits or focal scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular morphology and jagged pixel boundaries at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, indicating physical trauma or erosion.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniformly high-density dark pigmentation across the entire observable ventral area, devoid of standard species-typical white mottling.
